mentions.name: Kindle e-ink school dashboard
mentions.description: An e-ink dashboard built by hacking an old Kindle to display information for the author's daughter's school; the author plans to enhance it further and make it easy to customise, with a detailed write-up of the process.
mentions.source_excerpt: I hacked my old kindle and turned it into a eink dashboard for my daughter’s school! Now planning to enahace it a bit further and make it easy to customise.
